goal: Protect nodes from memory expansion and CPU resource exhaustion when receiving blocks
Reduce peak memory use and block deserialization time across the network

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it hardens peer message handling against memory-expansion denial-of-service attacks
Caps block deserialization memory expansion from seventeen bytes per received byte down to six

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it eliminates severe memory expansion and CPU exhaustion in serialization primitives
Worst-case block memory allocation drops from 112 MB to 4 MB and deserialization speeds up tenfold
